title: Mastering Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Complex Reasoning
excerpt: Learn how breaking down multi-step logic into explicit reasoning chains improves LLM accuracy by over 40% on coding and math tasks.
author: Dr. Elena Vance
content:
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is one of the most powerful techniques in modern AI engineering. By instructing the model to think step-by-step before delivering its final answer, we significantly reduce hallucination rates and improve logical consistency.

### Why CoT Works
Traditional zero-shot prompting forces the language model to calculate the entire sequence of probabilities in a single forward pass. When faced with complex multi-step logic, this often leads to superficial answers or errors.

```json
{
  "technique": "Chain of Thought",
  "accuracy_boost": "35-45%",
  "recommended_models": ["Claude 3.5 Sonnet", "GPT-4o", "Gemini 1.5 Pro"]
}
```

### Practical Structure
To implement CoT effectively in your prompts, append explicit reasoning instructions:

> 'Before providing the final solution, systematically analyze the problem in `<thinking>` tags. Step 1: Identify inputs. Step 2: Validate constraints. Step 3: Execute step-by-step logic.'

title: The Art of Vibe Coding: Autonomous Development with Antigravity
excerpt: Discover how senior engineers leverage natural language directives to orchestrate full-stack web apps effortlessly.
author: Marcus Sterling
content:
Vibe Coding represents a fundamental shift in software craftsmanship. Rather than writing every syntax character by hand, engineers act as high-level directors guiding autonomous AI agents like Google Antigravity.

### Key Principles of Effective Vibe Coding
1. **Provide Clear Architectural Guardrails**: Define design aesthetics, color palettes, and component boundaries up front.
2. **Iterative Verification**: Run live local preview servers and verify UI components visually.
3. **Deconstruct Large Requirements**: Break complex apps into modular phases.

title: System Prompt Hardening: Preventing Injection & Extraction
excerpt: A deep dive into defending your AI applications against prompt injection attacks, jailbreaks, and sensitive context leakage.
author: Sarah Lin
content: As LLM integration expands across SaaS products, prompt injection has emerged as a top OWASP AI security threat. Protect your application using defensive delimiter techniques and boundary isolation.
